Freight & storage

BEFORE GOODS MOVE.

Practical answers for planning the next shipment.

What information is needed for a quote?

Start with the collection and delivery locations, goods, package count, weight, dimensions, and preferred date. Include storage or special handling requirements.

Can I arrange both storage and dispatch?

Use the storage enquiry to describe stock levels, turnover, receiving frequency, and outbound needs. The team will review whether the arrangements fit your operation.

Is package volume the same as a delivery price?

No. The calculator converts packed dimensions to cubic metres. Route, weight, handling, and the proposed service also need to be reviewed for a quote.

Can I request a regular delivery schedule?

Yes. Share the delivery points, frequency, dispatch windows, and receiving constraints through the distribution enquiry.

Where should I include special cargo requirements?

Add them to the handling instructions in your enquiry. The team needs to review cargo such as temperature-sensitive goods or batteries before agreeing transport.
